constraint_name: Valid profile required before planner execution
notes: Rejects invalid household size, conflicting restrictions, missing budget for budget priority, and invalid max cooking time.

constraint_name: Planning horizon days must equal active policy
Meals per day must equal active policy
notes: Current default policy expects 3 meals per day.
Recipes exposing normalized allergen families are removed before optimization.
No Pork, No Beef, Vegetarian, Pescatarian, and Lactose Intolerant have explicit exclusion rules.
Recipes beyond the profile's max cooking time are excluded from the shortlist.

constraint_name: Exactly one recipe per meal slot
notes: The CP-SAT model chooses one allowed recipe per breakfast, lunch, and dinner slot.
Recipes are only assignable to allowed meal labels.
The solver retries with broader repeat caps if earlier attempts are infeasible.

constraint_name: Weekly budget hard cap when budget exists
notes: Cost optimization is only activated for budget priority, but the weekly budget cap itself is hard whenever a budget is resolved.
Deviation is penalized within tolerance bands.
Protein, carbohydrate, and fat deviations are penalized from daily targets.
Fiber targets are raised for some goals/symptoms and shortfall is penalized.
Penalty only works when sodium values exist in recipe data or corrections.
Sugar ceiling can be tightened by symptom adjustments.
Encourages diverse vegetable tokens across the week.
Pantry is rewarded, but NOT enforced as a hard feasibility constraint in current code.
